_description: E-042 SST arm: the f4-40M configuration on the r2 tensor (SST as channel 40). 512x12, 4 heads, d_dec 256, d_z 32, patch 1 — architecturally identical to f4-40M, which is the point: the only difference between this recipe and that one is the tensor, so the pair is an A/B on SST and nothing else.
_provenance: #386 measured this configuration on the r1 tensor (loss_rec 0.297 -> 0.212 by step 71,000, probe r 0.564 -> ~0.62, 190 ms/step steady, params 37,975,889). This recipe exists because f4-40M.json PINS "tensor": "family4_na025_pentad", and every consumption site in ml-train.yml and scripts/probes_run.sh reads ${RECIPE_TENSOR:-$IN_TENSOR} — so the recipe wins and a dispatch that also passes tensor: family4_na025_pentad_r2 would train r1 while provenance.json (raw toJSON(inputs)) recorded r2. E-042's plan section 5 told the reader to do exactly that; a green run reporting SST numbers for a run in which SST never appeared. Overriding a recipe's tensor from the dispatch is not possible, so the r2 arm gets its own recipe rather than an override. Params here are 37,976,465 (+576 over #386: chan_emb +512 and q_chan +64, one row each for channel 40).
